p: Cross KIA — McKeen assumes brigade. Hancock told Cross before the charge 'This is not your last battle, Colonel.' Cross reportedly replied 'I think this IS my last battle, General.' Reported time: July 2 ~5:45pm.

p: The morning of July 1 was warm and hazy when Corporal Alphonso Hodges spotted movement on the Chambersburg Pike. He reported to his sergeant: Confederate infantry, coming in force.
